BEGINNING OF CONVERSATION: USER: I have called the cops on my neighbor 10 times for being loud, the police say there is nothing they can do. I have no idea what is going on, constant screaming. ASSISTANT:

It is possible that your neighbor is engaging in protected activity, such as expressing their opinion or religious beliefs, and the police cannot intervene in these situations. You could try speaking to your neighbor directly to see if there is a way to resolve the issue. If that does not work, you could contact your local government representatives to express your concerns and see if they can help.
